title: Two-term constant-sheaf resolution of Z/ell^N and its tensor augmentation
statement:
Let $\ell$ be prime, $N\geq1$, and $\mathcal C$ a small site [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. Let $R=(\mathbf Z_\ell)_{\mathcal C}$ and $Q=(\mathbf Z/\ell^N\mathbf Z)_{\mathcal C}$ be constant sheaves [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf], with the coefficient rings of [def-weil-l-adic-numbers]. Use sheaves of modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], cochain complexes and quasi-isomorphisms [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules, def-pc-quasi-iso-modules], and total tensor [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves]. The complex $C=[R\xrightarrow{\ell^N}R]$, in degrees $-1,0$, has flat terms [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules], is K-flat [def-pc-kflat-complex], and its degree-zero quotient augmentation $\epsilon:C\to Q[0]$ is a quasi-isomorphism. For any $R$-module sheaf $L$ such that multiplication by $\ell^N$ is injective, the canonical augmentation
$$\operatorname{Tot}(L[0]\otimes_R C)\longrightarrow(L\otimes_R Q)[0]$$
is a quasi-isomorphism. Here the sheaf tensor product [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product] canonically identifies $L\otimes_R Q$ with $L/\ell^NL$, by $x\otimes\bar a\mapsto a[x]$.
